card.title: Reflexion: Language Agents with
card.task: Programming and decision-making tasks using large language models (LLMs)
card.method: Reflexion proposes a novel framework that uses verbal reinforcement learning, where agents verbally reflect on task feedback signals and maintain their own reflective text in an episodic memory buffer. This approach aims to help agents learn from prior failures and improve their performance on subsequent trials.
claims: Reflexion achieves 91% pass@1 accuracy on the HumanEval coding benchmark for Python, surpassing the previous state-of-the-art GPT-4 that achieves 80%.
Reflexion outperforms all baseline accuracies on various benchmarks for Python and Rust, except for MBPP Python.
Reflexion's performance is influenced by the quality of generated unit tests; flaky test suites can lead to false positive labels, which is a limitation of the Reflexion framework.
